items.informal_name: Coefficient Correspondence under Algebra Equivalence for Multivariate Polynomials with Option Variables
items.type:
∀ (R : Type u) {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : MvPolynomial (Option σ) R) (m : ℕ) (d : σ →₀ ℕ),
  MvPolynomial.coeff d (((MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft R σ) p).coeff m) = MvPolynomial.coeff (Finsupp.optionElim m d) p
items.informal_description: For any multivariate polynomial $ p $ over $ \text{Option}\, \sigma $ with coefficients in a commutative semiring $ R $, and for any natural number $ m $ and finite support function $ d : \sigma \to₀ \mathbb{N} $, the coefficient of $ d $ in the $ m $-th coefficient of the polynomial obtained via the algebra equivalence $ \text{optionEquivLeft} $ is equal to the coefficient of the monomial $ \text{optionElim}(m, d) $ in $ p $. Here, $ \text{optionElim}(m, d) $ denotes the monomial in $ \text{Option}\, \sigma $ that maps $ \text{none} $ to $ m $ and $ \text{some}\, s $ to $ d(s) $.

items.informal_name: Coefficient correspondence in algebra equivalence between multivariate polynomials over Option σ and polynomials in one variable with multivariate coefficients
items.type:
∀ (R : Type u) (S₁ : Type v) [inst : CommSemiring R] (n : Option S₁ →₀ ℕ) (f : MvPolynomial (Option S₁) R),
  MvPolynomial.coeff n.some (((MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft R S₁) f).coeff (n none)) = MvPolynomial.coeff n f
items.informal_description: For any finite support function $ n : \text{Option } \sigma \to₀ \mathbb{N} $ and polynomial $ f \in R[\text{Option } \sigma] $, the coefficient of the monomial corresponding to $ n $ restricted to $ \sigma $ in the polynomial obtained by evaluating the algebra equivalence at the variable corresponding to 'none' equals the coefficient of $ n $ in $ f $. Formally, $ \text{coeff}_{n.\text{some}}(\text{Polynomial.coeff}(\text{optionEquivLeft}(f), n(\text{none}))) = \text{coeff}_n(f) $.

items.informal_name: Algebra equivalence between multivariate polynomials over Option σ and polynomials in one variable with multivariate coefficients
items.type: (R : Type u) → (S₁ : Type v) → [inst : CommSemiring R] → MvPolynomial (Option S₁) R ≃ₐ[R] Polynomial (MvPolynomial S₁ R)
items.informal_description: The algebra equivalence between the ring of multivariate polynomials with variables indexed by $\text{Option } \sigma$ and coefficients in a commutative semiring $R$, and the polynomial ring in one variable whose coefficients are multivariate polynomials over $R$ with variables indexed by $\sigma$. This equivalence is constructed by evaluating variables in $\text{Option } \sigma$ as either the indeterminate of the outer polynomial ring (for the $\text{none}$ case) or coefficients in the inner multivariate polynomial ring (for the $\text{some } s$ cases), with the inverse given by substituting the renamed variables.

items.informal_name: Algebra equivalence between multivariate polynomial rings with Option variables and extended coefficient ring
items.type: (R : Type u) → (S₁ : Type v) → [inst : CommSemiring R] → MvPolynomial (Option S₁) R ≃ₐ[R] MvPolynomial S₁ (Polynomial R)
items.informal_description: An algebra equivalence over $ R $ between the multivariate polynomial ring with variables indexed by $ \text{Option } S_1 $ and the multivariate polynomial ring with variables indexed by $ S_1 $ but with coefficients in $ R[X] $. This equivalence is constructed by evaluating the 'none' variable as the indeterminate $ X $ in $ R[X] $ and mapping 'some i' variables to the corresponding $ X_i $ in $ S_1 $, establishing a bijective correspondence that preserves both ring structure and scalar multiplication by $ R $.

items.informal_name: Application of Algebra Equivalence for Optional Variables in Multivariate Polynomials
items.type:
∀ (R : Type u) (S₁ : Type v) [inst : CommSemiring R] (a : MvPolynomial (Option S₁) R),
  (MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft R S₁) a =
    (MvPolynomial.aeval fun o => o.elim Polynomial.X fun s => Polynomial.C (MvPolynomial.X s)) a
items.informal_description: The algebra equivalence between multivariate polynomials over $\text{Option } \sigma$ and polynomials in one variable with multivariate coefficients over $\sigma$ is defined by evaluating each variable in $\text{Option } \sigma$ as either the indeterminate of the outer polynomial ring (for the $\text{none}$ case) or as the constant polynomial with coefficient corresponding to the variable in $\sigma$ (for the $\text{some } s$ case).

items.informal_name: Support Membership in Coefficients Under Option Algebra Equivalence
items.type:
∀ (R : Type u) {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] {f : MvPolynomial (Option σ) R} {i : ℕ} {m : σ →₀ ℕ},
  m ∈ (((MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft R σ) f).coeff i).support ↔ Finsupp.optionElim i m ∈ f.support
items.informal_description: For a multivariate polynomial $ f $ with variables indexed by $ \text{Option } \sigma $, a monomial $ m : \sigma \to_0 \mathbb{N} $ lies in the support of the $ i $-th coefficient of the polynomial obtained via the algebra equivalence $ \text{optionEquivLeft} $ if and only if the monomial constructed by setting the $ \text{none} $ case to $ i $ and the $ \text{some } s $ cases to $ m(s) $ belongs to the original support of $ f $.

items.type:
∀ (R : Type u) (S₁ : Type v) [inst : CommSemiring R] (a : MvPolynomial (Option S₁) R),
  (MvPolynomial.optionEquivRight R S₁) a =
    (MvPolynomial.aeval fun o => o.elim (MvPolynomial.C Polynomial.X) MvPolynomial.X) a
items.informal_description: For any commutative semiring $ R $ and type $ S $, there exists an algebra equivalence between the multivariate polynomial ring $ R[\text{Option } S] $ and the multivariate polynomial ring $ R[X][S] $. This equivalence is constructed by interpreting the 'none' variable as the indeterminate $ X $ in $ R[X] $, while mapping 'some $ i $' variables to the corresponding variables in $ S $. The equivalence preserves addition, multiplication, and scalar multiplication by $ R $, establishing a bijective correspondence between these two algebraic structures.

items.informal_name: Constant Polynomial Preservation in Algebra Equivalence between Multivariate Polynomials over Option σ and Polynomials with Multivariate Coefficients
items.type:
∀ (R : Type u) (S₁ : Type v) [inst : CommSemiring R] (r : R),
  (MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft R S₁) (MvPolynomial.C r) = Polynomial.C (MvPolynomial.C r)
items.informal_description: For any element $ r $ in a commutative semiring $ R $, the algebra equivalence between the multivariate polynomial ring $ R[\text{Option } \sigma] $ and the polynomial ring $ R[\sigma][X] $ maps the constant polynomial $ C(r) $ in $ R[\text{Option } \sigma] $ to the constant polynomial $ C(C(r)) $ in $ R[\sigma][X] $. This shows that constant polynomials are preserved under this equivalence by nesting the constant embedding in both polynomial structures.
